home.lede: Freelance web & mobile developer. Nuxt.js, NestJS, React Native — and Solidity for Web3 projects.

about.label: About
about.heading: Not a developer. A technical partner for your business.
about.p1: I solve business problems with code — not the other way around. When you describe your situation, I look for the economic lever first, the technical solution second.
about.p2: 4+ years building web platforms, mobile apps, internal tools and APIs for SMEs and startups, from MVP to production.
about.p3: Dual stack: Web2 as primary (Nuxt, NestJS, React Native) and Web3 when the project genuinely calls for it — Solidity smart contracts, on-chain integrations, tokenomics.
about.pull: The real problem is almost never technical.
